LARATA-RAT_INVITATION.pages.ACCEPTED.des:
The doors groan open. Somewhere beyond them, iron boots strike stone.

The laughter stops.

"At last. Guests worthy of my table."
LARATA-RAT_INVITATION.pages.DECLINED.des:
You turn away. The green light narrows to a thread, then vanishes.

Behind the stone, a crown scrapes against a throne.

"Another time, then."
LARATA-RAT_INVITATION.pages.INITIAL.desc:
The Spire falls silent. Then, beneath the stone, something laughs.

An emerald slit opens in the darkness. Beyond it waits a throne of broken crowns, and upon that throne, two hungry green eyes.

A voice slips through the crack. "So. You thought yourselves finished. Come closer, little heroes. Let us see what your triumph is worth."
LARATA-RAT_INVITATION.pages.INITIAL.opti: Follow the laughter beneath the throne.
Leave the crown to its shadows. The Architect awaits.
LARATA-RAT_INVITATION.title: You Are Not Prepared
